definition: Boisterous means loud, energetic, and exuberant in a cheerful, high-spirited way that can spill into rowdiness.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word boisterous. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know boisterous should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The boisterous night market roared with vendors' calls, sizzling grills, and kids racing between the stalls.
Lively means pleasantly energetic; boisterous adds real volume and a touch of rowdiness to that energy.
Riotous goes beyond boisterous — noise and wildness so extreme they border on genuine chaos.

Rowdy means noisy and disorderly -- the noise has tipped into real misbehavior: shoving, breaking things, ignoring every call for order. Boisterous is loud and energetic too, but in a cheerful, good-natured way; a boisterous party is still fun to be at, while a rowdy one has guests you want to throw out.

Rollicking means exuberantly lively and fun -- a rollicking comedy or party sweeps everyone along in carefree high spirits, and the word is pure compliment. Boisterous shares the energy but centers on volume and near-chaos, and it can carry a mild edge of 'a bit much.' Rollicking is fun described fondly; boisterous is loudness that may need settling down.

Then the retriever puppies discovered the tug ropes, and the gym exploded into happy barking, skidding paws, and one overturned water bowl.

Every December, four generations of the Reyes family squeeze into one small kitchen to make tamales.
The work is loud from the first hour: cousins shout orders over the radio, uncles argue happily about the right amount of chile, and somebody's toddler bangs a pot lid like a cymbal.
Neighbors passing the window might mistake the boisterous scene for a quarrel -- until they hear the laughter under the noise.
Nothing is ever broken and nobody storms out.
The volume is simply how the family enjoys itself.
By midnight the trays are full, the kitchen is wrecked in the friendliest possible way, and the youngest cousins are asleep under the table.
